description: Source code for prompt templating and rendering functions in an autocomplete service, including prompt preparation, token limit handling, and prompt building.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the autocomplete template for a given model name.

methods.name: preparePromptContext
methods.description: Prepares context data such as prefix, suffix, reponame, template, snippets, and options for prompt rendering.

methods.name: renderPrompt
methods.description: Generates a prompt with optional stop tokens based on helper variables and context.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the final prompt string, applying prefix/suffix compilation or formatting.

methods.name: pruneLength
methods.description: Calculates how many tokens need to be pruned from the prompt to fit within the model's context length.

methods.name: renderPromptWithTokenLimit
methods.description: Generates a prompt with token limit enforcement, truncating prefix/suffix as needed.
